hero.title: TESA® LASIK: Flap-Free, Blade-Free Laser Vision Correction at OPTIMAX
sub: A Surface-Based LASIK Alternative for Active Lifestyles and Sensitive Eyes

items.v: Not everyone is a candidate for traditional LASIK, especially if you have thin corneas, dry eyes, or lead an active lifestyle. That’s why OPTIMAX Eye Specialist offers TESA® (Transepithelial Surface Ablation) — a flapless, no-blade laser vision correction procedure designed for safety, simplicity, and long-term clarity.

TESA® (also referred to as TransPRK) is a non-invasive surface-based laser treatment that removes the corneal epithelium and reshapes the underlying tissue in a single step — using an excimer laser.
There are no blades, no mechanical instruments, and no corneal flap. Healing begins immediately as the epithelium naturally regenerates.
Technology Used: SCHWIND AMARIS® 1050RS Excimer Laser
At OPTIMAX, TESA® procedures are performed using the SCHWIND AMARIS® 1050RS excimer laser system — known for:

v: High-speed ablation for shorter procedure time
Flap-free = no risk of flap complications
Suitable for thin or irregular corneas
Good choice for physically active patients

items.v: *Suitability is determined by a full eye assessment with our specialists.
TESA® is well-suited for individuals who:

v: Are not eligible for LASIK or SMILE due to corneal thickness
Engage in contact sports or high-risk physical activities
Have dry eyes or a sensitive ocular surface

items.v: Consultation is required to determine the safest option for your eyes.

no.heading: Who Is Not Suitable for TESA®?

items.v: TESA® may not be recommended if you:

v: Have unstable vision or a changing prescription
Are diagnosed with keratoconus or severe corneal disorders

items.v: Alternative treatments like ZEISS SMILE or ICL may be better options.
